name: Ichijou Kyoushirou
source:
A professor doing basic medical research, born in a former Kazoku family.
He is basically not interested in anything other than research, and he really wants to stay in the laboratory and do research all day long.
Private life is appropriate and food is sloppy.

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/nemurihime/chara/kyoushirou_ichijyou.html]official website[/url]]
